opportunities.title: Research Project Grants – Detailed Applications
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Researchers based at UK universities or other institutions of higher education; also UK-based independent research institutes/organisations on a trial basis. PI must be employed by the eligible institution. Up to three co-applicants allowed.
opportunities.summary: Funds innovative and original research projects held for up to five years. Two-stage assessment (Outline then Detailed); this is the Detailed Application stage for invited applicants, due 1 September 2026.

opportunities.title: Research Project Grants – Outline Applications
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Researchers based at UK universities or other institutions of higher education; also UK-based independent research institutes/organisations on a trial basis.
opportunities.summary: Outline-stage applications for innovative and original research projects. The outline stage is currently paused and will be accepted in the new grants management system in autumn 2026.

opportunities.title: Visiting Professorships

amount.raw: Applications are invited for a minimum of £10,000 and a maximum of £150,000.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applications made by a member of academic staff at a UK university with research degree awarding powers who coordinates the visit; some specialist arts institutions permitted. Visiting professor must be an eminent senior professor from overseas.
opportunities.summary: Funds UK institutions to invite an eminent senior professor from overseas to bring novel expertise and enhance skills and knowledge in an underrepresented research area. Visits last 3-12 months.
discipline_tags: All subject areas except studies of disease/illness and medical applications

opportunities.title: Early Career Fellowships

amount.raw: £130,000. Trust contributes 100% of salary up to £56,000 in year one and 50% up to £28,000 in years two and three, plus up to £6,000 per year research expenses.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early career researchers with a research record who have not yet held a full-time permanent academic post; must hold a doctorate by taking up the Fellowship and be building a UK academic career.
opportunities.summary: Three-year Fellowships enabling early career researchers to undertake a significant piece of publishable work, tenable at UK universities with research degree awarding powers.
discipline_tags: All subject areas except studies of disease/illness and medical applications

opportunities.title: Leverhulme Centenary Doctoral Scholarships

amount.raw: Ten awards of up to £5 million each.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Any UK university that holds research degree awarding powers in its own right; consortia of up to two universities allowed. Applications submitted by a principal applicant from the lead university.
opportunities.summary: Funds up to 30 Leverhulme Doctoral Scholarships in an interdisciplinary priority research area per institution, each grant running over 9 years, including additional studentships, postdoctoral funding and admin support. Now open for submission in March 2026.
discipline_tags: All subject areas within the Trust's remit (excludes medical/clinical, policy-driven and commercial research)

opportunities.title: Leverhulme Centenary Research Centres

amount.raw: Up to £10 million available for up to 10 years.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK universities registered by the Office for Students and holding their own research degree awarding powers; single university or collaborations; previously excluded institutions (Oxford, Cambridge, Imperial) eligible this round.
opportunities.summary: Funds the establishment of Leverhulme Research Centres for outstanding original research aspiring to achieve a step-change in scholarship. Round expected to open in February 2027 with outline applications due June 2027.
discipline_tags: Any topic within the Trust's remit (blue-skies, transformative, multidisciplinary)

opportunities.title: Major Research Fellowships

amount.raw: Replacement salary costs for the duration of the Fellowship, plus research expenses up to an annual maximum of £6,000.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Well-established, distinguished researchers in the humanities and social sciences employed at an eligible UK university with research degree awarding powers. Previous holders not eligible.
opportunities.summary: Fellowships of two or three years for distinguished researchers in the humanities and social sciences to complete a piece of original research, funding replacement salary costs.

opportunities.title: Philip Leverhulme Prizes
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Researchers at an early stage of their careers with international impact, holding a permanent post or long-term fellowship in a UK university with research degree awarding powers; nominated by head of department. Doctoral degree normally awarded not more than ten years prior to closing date.
opportunities.summary: Prizes of £100,000 over 2-3 years for early career researchers whose work has had international impact, usable for any research purpose. The 2026 round closed 14 May 2026; next round closes in 2027.

opportunities.title: Research Fellowships

amount.raw: The maximum total value of a Fellowship is £70,000.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Experienced researchers holding a post in a UK university with research degree awarding powers that extends beyond the Fellowship, resident in the UK, with an established track record. Priority to those whose teaching/admin duties impeded research.
opportunities.summary: Fellowships of 3-24 months for experienced researchers in any discipline to complete a piece of research, providing replacement costs and research expenses. Application materials available on the page in September 2026.
discipline_tags: All subject areas except studies of disease/illness and medical applications

opportunities.title: Centenary Research Leadership Awards

amount.raw: Awards will be for up to £1 million, for staff salaries and associated costs.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Talented early career academics at lecturer level or equivalent with at least two years' post-PhD experience, holding or being nominated for a permanent academic appointment at a UK university. Each institution limited to one bid.
opportunities.summary: Awards of up to £1 million over 4-5 years to build a research team of sufficient scale to tackle a distinctive research problem. Will open in January 2028 for submission in May 2028.
discipline_tags: All research areas within the Trust's remit (excludes medical/clinical, policy-driven, advocacy and commercial research)

opportunities.title: Emeritus Fellowships

amount.raw: Applications are invited for a minimum value of £3,000 and a maximum of £24,000.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Senior researchers who have retired or partially retired from an academic post, living in the UK for a minimum of 26 weeks per year, with an established record of research. Requires institutional approval from the 2026 round onwards.
opportunities.summary: Fellowships of 3-24 months for retired or partially retired senior researchers to complete a research project and prepare results for publication. Application materials available during September 2026.
discipline_tags: All subject areas except studies of disease/illness and medical applications

opportunities.title: Art Scholarship – Training Opportunities (Under 18s)

amount.raw: Each institution can apply for a maximum total award of £475,000.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Specialist arts training institutions or registered charities that can evidence outstanding quality teaching; non-specialist arts schools and multi-faculty universities not eligible. One application per round.
opportunities.summary: Three-year awards supporting arts training for school-age children under 18 outside regular school hours (weekends, evenings, holidays), including bursaries and outreach activities. Triennial scheme, next round closing 2027.

opportunities.title: Art Scholarship – Bursaries for Undergraduates and Postgraduates

amount.raw: Each institution can apply for a maximum total award of £475,000. Bursaries of £5,000 to £10,000 a year per student.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Specialist arts training institutions that demonstrate outstanding quality teaching and offer degrees at undergraduate or postgraduate taught level; university departments teaching fine and performing arts not eligible. One application per round.
opportunities.summary: Provides bursaries of £5,000-£10,000 per year for outstanding undergraduate and/or postgraduate students in financial need at specialist arts institutions. Triennial scheme, next round closing 2027.
